title: TUI: restore the vertical round rail, keeping the label-sized agent graph
scenario: Replay the bundled bad-cpp full-lifecycle fixture to completion, enter the selected experiment summary, then enter Round 1.

before.observed: One horizontal round tab appears above a two-column agents/transcript layout.

after.observed: A 28-column Rounds rail occupies the left column, followed by agents and transcript; orchestrator, implementer, judge, and profiler remain untruncated.

commands: tui-test run --backend alacritty --cols 160 --rows 45 --env TERM=xterm-256color clients/tui/dev/mock-ui.sh --speed 0 --theme dark
tui-test record start PNG; tui-test record stop
limitations: This 160-column pair demonstrates the full rail. It does not separately capture the compact 13-column rail at 85-99 columns or the collapsed state below 85 columns. The fixture is a scrubbed real capture and omits newer execution identity fields, which the harness translates through its normal legacy path.
